description:
List participants behind a churn category

The drill-down: the participant IDs behind one churn category count for this Provider over the period, newest observation day first. `counterpart` narrows a mover category to the participants won from or lost to one Provider. Cursor-paginated in pages of at most 500: follow `next_cursor` until it is null. A Vendor key (`v-<slug>`) lists the Vendor's events, also accepts `newly_matched` and `no_longer_matched`, and adds `counterpart_kind` to each item.

category.description: The churn category to expand. `newly_matched` and `no_longer_matched` are valid for a Vendor key only; with a Provider key they are a 400.

counterpart.description: Filter to one counterpart Provider key: the Provider the participants were won from (`mover_in`) or lost to (`mover_out`). Allowed with the two mover categories only. For a Vendor key the counterpart can also be a Vendor key. An unknown key returns an empty list.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as `next_cursor` by the previous page.

key.description: The Provider key, or a Vendor key (`v-<slug>`).

limit.description: Page size, clamped to [1, 500]. Defaults to 500 (20 through MCP).

name: list_access_point_churn_participants
